name: UNRWA USA
mission: UNRWA USA lifts up the voices, experiences, and humanity of Palestine refugees to secure American support for resources essential to every human being, for the promise of a better life.
theoryOfChange: Until there is a just solution to their plight, UNRWA USA envisions a world where Palestine refugees thrive.In line with our mission, we strive to re-shape the narrative around Palestine refugees and UNRWA in the United States to inspire a network of advocates, donors, and fundraisers committed to bettering the lives of Palestine refugees.

rich_narrative.summary: UNRWA USA lifts up the voices and lives of Palestine refugees through targeted humanitarian assistance, education, healthcare, and emergency response in crisis regions like Gaza, the West Bank, and Syria. In FY2024, the organization managed <cite id="13">Total Revenue of $51,495,126</cite> to expand its life-saving initiatives. The organization operates with exceptional fiscal efficiency, directing a <cite id="1">Program expense ratio of 95.2%</cite> toward direct services, which beats the <cite id="1">75% sector benchmark</cite> and exceeds the <cite id="1">peer median of 89.5%</cite>. Furthermore, UNRWA USA spends just <cite id="1">$0.04 to raise every $1</cite>, demonstrating disciplined operational management. Muslim donors can confidently support the organization, as it maintains <cite id="2">verified zakat eligibility</cite> across key categories like fuqara and masakin. Holding an <cite id="1">overall rating of 91.0/100 from Charity Navigator</cite> and a <cite id="1">Candid Platinum Seal of Transparency</cite>, UNRWA USA stands out as a highly reliable channel for humanitarian giving.
